note: Two clauses, both asserted. Sender: TestRFC9494_FlagsReservedBitsZeroOnSend fails unless the encoded Flags octet is exactly 0x80 (any reserved bit set goes red). Receiver: TestRFC9494_FlagsReservedBitsIgnoredOnReceive fails if a 0xFF Flags octet errors or decodes differently from 0x80, and if 0x7F leaks into the F bit.
